nodes.text: If it rolls, I mend it. If it doesn't roll, that's why you're here. Which cart's yours?

choices.text: What breaks most on the High Road?

nodes.text: The descent. That last league drops like a dropped thing, and carters ride the brake till the shoe glazes, then take the crag corner with glazed shoes. Axles I can save. Wheels, usually. Pride, no. I keep a shelf of the worst failures as a museum. The carters pretend to hate it. They bring visitors.

First cottage on the Row, hedge and all. Built the door myself, hung it myself, planed it three times because the frame and I disagreed about what square meant. My wife keeps the garden through the wicket and I keep the woodpile, and between the two of us the house behaves. Mostly her doing. The woodpile just makes me look useful.
Grease the hubs before the descent, not after. After is a story I get paid to hear.
